title: Robotics Engineer (development seed)
summary: Designs, builds, and tests systems that sense and move.

steps.title: Practice programming
steps.description: Write a small program that uses conditions and loops.

steps.title: Explore circuits
steps.description: Identify the parts of a simple circuit and explain how they work together.

steps.title: Work with sensors
steps.description: Sketch how a sensor can guide a robot through a simple task.

steps.title: Plan and test a prototype
steps.description: Sketch a robot and write a plan to test its behavior.

title: Environmental Scientist (development seed)
summary: Studies the environment and uses evidence to understand changes.

steps.title: Describe a local ecosystem
steps.description: List the living and nonliving things you observe in a familiar place.

steps.title: Plan a measurement
steps.description: Choose a variable to measure and write down how to collect it consistently.

steps.title: Summarize observations
steps.description: Organize sample observations and identify one pattern.

steps.title: Explain a finding
steps.description: Write a short explanation that connects a claim to your observations.
